Worker.// HealthListenAddress: localhost is the documented dev-time override (no firewall prompts on dev machines/CI agents); the shipped default '*' is the all-interfaces container posture.

Messaging.// AutoProvision: Not set: on in Development (the E2E fixture runs this host as Development), off elsewhere.
